title: Rubric: Bird Base Petal Fold Crease Inversion Sequence

criteria.name: Criterion for CLM-01
criteria.description: Step 1: Crease diagonal valley folds and orthogonal mountain folds, then collapse into a 1/4 size preliminary square with open corner facing learner. [source_claim_id: CLM-01]
criteria.observable_indicator: Crease diagonal valley folds and orthogonal mountain folds, then collapse into a 1/4 size preliminary square with open corner facing learner.

criteria.name: Criterion for CLM-02
criteria.description: Step 2: Lift top flap upward while simultaneously reversing lateral mountain creases into valley folds along the central symmetry axis. [source_claim_id: CLM-02]
criteria.observable_indicator: Lift top flap upward while simultaneously reversing lateral mountain creases into valley folds along the central symmetry axis.
